import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "585fbf9340de57a9bc6fcd662e5979bb37a9c7c9"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=wt, text=True, capture_output=True, check=check, env=env)

head = run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch = run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
if head != expected or branch != "feat/self-dogfood-20261007":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} branch={branch}")

p = wt/"src/do_again/browser/runtime.py"
text = p.read_text()

if "import secrets\n" not in text:
    text = text.replace("import os\n", "import os\nimport secrets\n", 1)

bad = '''def _rollover_needed(target: cdp.Target) -> bool:
    warning = _context_limit_warning(target)
    if warning or _rollover_needed(target):
        return True
'''
good = '''def _rollover_needed(target: cdp.Target) -> bool:
    warning = _context_limit_warning(target)
    if warning:
        return True
'''
if bad not in text:
    raise SystemExit("recursive rollover helper pattern not found")
text = text.replace(bad, good, 1)

gate = '''    warning = _context_limit_warning(target)
    if warning:
        if _assistant_snapshot(target).get("busy"):
            raise BrowserError(
                "context limit detected while ChatGPT is still busy; retrying later"
            )
'''
replacement = '''    if _rollover_needed(target):
        if _assistant_snapshot(target).get("busy"):
            raise BrowserError(
                "rollover needed while ChatGPT is still busy; retrying later"
            )
'''
if gate not in text:
    raise SystemExit("notify rollover gate pattern not found")
text = text.replace(gate, replacement, 1)
p.write_text(text)

env = os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(wt/"src")
run(["python3","-m","py_compile","src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","tests/test_browser_hardening.py"], env=env)
print("py_compile=ok")

focused = run(
    ["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_browser_hardening","tests.test_browser"],
    check=False,
    env=env,
)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print("focused_rc=" + str(focused.returncode))
if focused.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

run(["git","add","src/do_again/browser/runtime.py","tests/test_browser_hardening.py"])
commit = run(["git","commit","-m","Add transactional chat rollover foundation"], check=False)
print("=== commit stdout ===")
print(commit.stdout)
print("=== commit stderr ===")
print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)

print("new_head=" + run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after=" + repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
